about_the_game:
🍰 The Adventure of Tsumugi, the VTuber Summoned to Sweets Planet!

To save her friend Chrome, VTuber Tsumugi Urajiro stands up against the chocolate-supremacist Dolce Empire in this pop and sweet 3D sandbox action-adventure!

While relaxing in the metaverse, Tsumugi receives a letter.

It's an SOS from her friend Chrome, who has been captured by the Dolce Empire.

The Sweets Planet, a world of cute confectionery kingdoms, has fallen under the rule of the Chocolate Empire...

With her Sweets Compact in hand, Tsumugi embarks on a journey through the various nations using "Sweets Change"!

Confront unique princesses, collect their respective "proofs," and put a stop to the empire's ambitions.

A sweet and chaotic adventure begins on a whip cream breeze!

🎀 Key Features

1. Strategy meets Transformation! — The "Sweets Change" System

The game's main feature allows the pop VTuber protagonist, Tsumugi, to instantly switch between four "Sweets Modes."

This isn't just about changing attacks; it's a strategic action system that can alter the environment itself.

Mode NameFeatures and Strategic Uses🍦 Ice PrincessFreeze liquids and enemies to create temporary footholds or set up chain reactions.🍫 Chocolat BlasterMelt ice with chocolate spray and perform precise long-range attacks.🍭 Candy HammerSmash obstacles with a giant hammer. Shatter frozen enemies to trigger devastating combos.☁️ Cotton Candy FairyPerfect for long-distance travel and slowing your descent. An essential mode for exploring large stages.

Switch between modes according to the situation. By chaining actions like freezing → smashing → flying → shooting, the possibilities for conquering stages are endless.

2. High-Freedom Sandbox Action

Dash through a miniature world made of furniture and sweets with responsive controls.

Wall kicks, triple jumps, and the cotton candy float will put your skills to the test.

Experience precise, inertia-based controls reminiscent of classic 3D action games from the GameCube era.

For a true challenge, take on high-difficulty platforming sections where you can't rely on the cotton candy float, offering a tough-as-nails experience behind its cute visuals.

3. Unique and Flavorful Sweets Worlds

From the Strawberry Princess's Cake Kingdom to the Matcha Princess's Teahouse Garden and the Banana Princess's Fruit Archipelago—

each world features different gimmicks, puzzles, and fascinating bosses.

Developed in Unreal Engine by a single person in about four months.

Thanks to thorough optimization, the game is only about 1GB and runs smoothly even on a GTX 1030!

This world is built with incredible technology, balancing high quality with brisk performance.

4. Collect, Grow, and Socialize

Collect Super Chocolates to buy items at the shop!

Each stage hides "Special Sweets," making exploration a delight.

Interact with friends and upgrade your skills in the hub world, "Whip Town."

Watch the town's scenery and conversations change as the story progresses.

And for those who master the Sweets Change system, a "special challenge" may be waiting...

5. Full Voice Acting with Synthesized Voices & Original Music

This title features voice synthesis characters developed by Project Unreally.

  • Tsumugi Urajiro (CV: Shion Yayo / MYCOEIROINK)

  • Sakuya Kodachi (CV: Koyori Nohana / MYCOEIROINK)

The main theme and ending songs are original vocal tracks performed by the respective voice actors.

Music & Arrangement: "Maninu Nonomura" / Lyrics: "Koyori Nohana"

Enjoy the "gentle, bittersweet sweets-pop" that colors the world of the game.

A sweet, kind, and slightly wacky adventure awaits you!

🎮 Try the Demo!

Playable Content

  • You can play up to the defeat of the Stage 1 boss and obtain the Super Chocolate.

Save Data

  • Save data from the demo version can be transferred to the full version of the game.

Demo Completion Bonus

  • Clear the demo to unlock the "Chocolat Blaster" early in the full game!

Convenient Quick Reset Function

  • By turning this ON in the options menu, you can instantly restart Stage 1 from the pause menu with a single touch.

  • This completely skips the loading time of returning to the title screen, making it perfect for practice or speedrun attempts.

  • This feature is OFF by default to prevent accidental resets during normal gameplay.

short_description: A pop-style 3D sandbox action adventure in a world of sweets! Use your “Sweets Change” mode to blast chocolate or freeze it with ice for slippery chain reactions. Collect over 200 Super Chocolates and explore a relaxing, sugar-filled world full of sweet surprises!
